# Mauricio Zambrano-Bigiarini

Mauricio Zambrano-Bigiarini is an Associate Professor in Civil Engineering at Universidad de La Frontera, Chile, and leads the Water Resources Observatory Kimün-Ko. His work connects hydrology, hydrometeorology, data science, environmental modelling, and open-source scientific software.

Primary topics: hydrological and hydrometeorological modelling; gridded precipitation, evapotranspiration, and soil-moisture datasets; drought monitoring; flood and streamflow forecasting; catchment responses to extreme events; climate-risk assessment; global optimisation; sensitivity and uncertainty analysis; R programming.
